name: harness-workflow
description: Practical Codex workflow skills for project-level harness bootstrap, decoupled workflow state, planning, verification, review, and clean handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Daily project harness workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turns Learn Harness Engineering ideas into practical Codex skills for project-level harness bootstrap, decoupled workflow state backends, planning, implementation, verification, review, and clean handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use brainstorm to turn unclear requirements into an approved spec with a verification strategy before planning.
Use state-contract when workflow state, three files, feature lists, or recovery backend need to be selected or repaired.
Use bootstrap to build or audit the project-level harness: AGENTS.md, project map, iron laws, verification, state, skills, hooks, subagents, and MCP policy.
Use plan to create or refresh the execution contract using the chosen workflow state backend; default is task_plan.md, progress.md, and findings.md.
Use verify before claiming tracked work is ready.
